summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of CRM Cold Sales. 45/45 backend pytest cases pass after fixing one routing bug. Frontend loads, all 10 nav pages accessible, login/dashboard/organizations/queue/templates/settings/toggle-sending flows verified.

critical.issue: ROUTE ORDERING BUG (FIXED by testing agent). /{org_id}/status was declared BEFORE /bulk/status, so FastAPI matched /bulk/status as org_id='bulk' → 500 InvalidId. Fixed by moving bulk endpoints above /{org_id}/... routes in /app/backend/routers/organizations.py.

minor.issue: Uses `body: StatusBody = None` where StatusBody has required `status` field. Client sending {'reason': '...'} gets 422. Either loosen validation or introduce dedicated DncBody(reason: Optional[str]).

Lockout identifier is `ip:email`. In K8s ingress, ingress-controller uses ≥2 pod IPs, so each source IP builds its own counter — 5 attempts hit each IP separately. Not a security issue (still limits per IP), but delays lockout. Consider identifier = email-only or normalize via X-Forwarded-For.
Accepts a bare `token: str = ''` query parameter that is unused (endpoint uses Depends(get_current_user)). Dead code — can be removed.

action_items: REVIEW: verify the route-ordering fix in /app/backend/routers/organizations.py (bulk/status + bulk/archive moved above /{org_id}/status). No behavioural change, just correct routing.

FIX (minor): make POST /organizations/{id}/dnc accept optional body cleanly — e.g. `body: Optional[DncBody] = None` with `DncBody(BaseModel): reason: Optional[str] = None`. Currently frontend must send a fake `status` to satisfy StatusBody validation.
IMPROVE (minor): brute-force identifier ideally should be per-email (or per-forwarded-for) to be resilient behind ingress load-balancing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware added AFTER include_router — that still works in FastAPI (Starlette applies middleware to the whole stack on first request), but keeping middleware setup before routers is clearer.
server.py: shutdown handler does not cancel _worker_task before closing Mongo client → the queue loop may log errors on shutdown. Minor.

worker.py: process_queue does not use pymongo findAndModify to atomically claim a task; two concurrent processors (background loop + manual /queue/process) can race and send twice. Currently mitigated by fast mock, but for real send this is unsafe.

backups.py: on restore, existing collections are wiped with delete_many({}) before insert — no transaction / atomic swap. If insert fails mid-way DB is empty. Consider dropping into a temp collection then renameCollection().
organizations.py: build_query uses raw user input in $regex without escaping — a search containing regex metacharacters can produce invalid queries or unintended matches. Wrap with re.escape().
constants.py: Q_SENT = 'Отправлено' collides with STATUS_SENT = 'Отправлено' — different collections so it works, but adds cognitive load; consider distinct labels.
imports.py: _read_df loads whole file into memory; no row cap — a malicious 100k-row XLSX will OOM. Add row limit and file-size limit on /import/upload.
auth.py: change-password does not invalidate other sessions of the same user — user with stolen token can keep using it after password change.

helpers.normalize_phone: unusual branch `if len(digits) == 11 and digits[0] == '9': digits = '7' + digits[-10:]` is unreachable when the previous 11-digit branch (starts with 8/7) already handled it; also for 12+ digits it silently keeps last 10 which may hide bad data.
queue.py enqueue: does not validate that scheduled_at is a future ISO date.
updated_files: /app/backend/routers/organizations.py (reordered bulk routes to fix 500 on bulk/status and bulk/archive)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` from /app. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as base. Note: brute-force test does 20 attempts to overcome K8s ingress IP load-balancing. If future changes make ingress route all through a single IP, this can be reduced. Route ordering was fixed once — if E1 restructures organizations.py, make sure /bulk/* endpoints remain declared BEFORE /{org_id}/* endpoints.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the bulk/status 500: FastAPI resolves routes in registration order. In routers/organizations.py, `POST /{org_id}/status` was declared at line 206, and `POST /bulk/status` at line 269. Any POST to `/api/organizations/bulk/status` matched the earlier route with org_id='bulk', which was then passed to ObjectId('bulk') → bson.errors.InvalidId → 500. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/organizations/bulk/status -H 'Authorization: Bearer <t>' -d '{"ids":[...],"status":"Готов к отправке"}'`. Mitigation applied: moved /bulk/status and /bulk/archive above /{org_id}/... routes. General rule: literal path segments must be declared before parameterised ones in FastAPI.
